array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/logs" "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/data" "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/state" "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/run" && export KYUDEN_PROFILE_DIR="$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/state/chrome-profile" KYUDEN_LOCK="$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/run/collector.lock" TZ=Asia/Tokyo && if [[ -f "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/secrets/kyuden.env" ]]; then set -a; source "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/secrets/kyuden.env"; set +a; fi && exec "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/.venv/bin/python" "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/collector.py" -m hourly --db "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/data/kyuden.sqlite" >> "$HOME/kyuden-data-collector/logs/kyuden-hourly.log" 2>&1
